_how: v0.5.0: PoB data 0.1 vs 0.2 (official notes blocked, 403): real = base damage at gem level 20 cut 20%+, or the conditional multiplier cut (Lightning Conduit). Lenient: a base cut is not proof the flagged condition was why. Hammer of the Gods also lost its cooldown, so its cut may not be a nerf. The skeletons, Raise Zombie and Detonate Minion are not comparable (unjudged). | v0.8.0 (tools/old_skill_verdicts.py, 0.2 vs 0.3, same rule): Sunder is real by its conditional (guaranteed crit vs broken armour and +100% crit damage removed). Spearfield's hidden 300% was removed but its base went up x4.16, so not a cut. Reworked, so unjudged: Blood Hunt, Snipe, Solar Orb (one part x0.67, another x1.35), Killing Palm, Shattering Palm. Minions unjudged. On 0.1, Detonate Dead's corpse damage fell 20% to 10.7% of life: false by the rule's letter, arguably real. | v0.5.0 Archmage: gain per 100 mana 6% to 3%; Irongrasp: item text unchanged (tools/old_verdicts.py). | v0.12.2 (0.3 vs 0.4): Lightning Conduit real by its multiplier (20 to 10 per 5% Shock); Raise Zombie, skeletons, Elemental Siphon (gone) unjudged. | v0.12.2 matrix (old_verdicts.py): text unchanged, or only gained a line (Sands of Silk, The Coming Calamity) = not cut; Maligaro's Virtuosity got a restriction unrelated to its size: unjudged. | v0.8.0 matrix (old_verdicts.py, 2026-11-24): real = Crown of Eyes (150% -> 100%) and Maligaro's Virtuosity (300% -> 250%); other changed lines are wording or buffs; Hyrri's Ire reworked (defence line), unjudged. | v0.15.0 (2026-11-26, 0.4 vs current PoB = 0.5): old_skill_verdicts.py (now also reads hidden player variants, e.g. SiegeCascadePlayer; earlier tags unchanged) -> Cross Slash real by the rule's letter (first part 471% -> 235% base, second part unchanged); minions, spectres, companions unjudged. Matrix (old_verdicts.py): 15 unchanged, Ming's Heart reworded only (Global Defences -> Armour, Evasion and ES) = not cut; Prism of Belief not in 0.4's item data: unjudged. | task 51 re-grade (2026-11-27, scans on 2cbc6d6 in old51/): new flagged pieces judged with the same tools and rule. Not cut / unchanged -> false. Real: Ingenuity 0.1 (40-80% bonuses from rings -> 20-30% from left ring), Effigy of Cruelty 0.2 (3-5 -> 1-3 Critical Weakness stacks) and 0.3 (60-80% -> 40-50% spell damage), Maligaro's Virtuosity 0.3 (gains 'Critical Hit Chance cannot be Rerolled'), Rathpith Globe 0.3 (5% -> 3% crit per 100 life, damage line removed), Solar Orb 0.2 by the rule's letter (one part x0.67, others x1.34-1.35). False on reading: Sacred Flame 0.2 (line order), Cursecarver / Enezun's Charge / Sanguine Diviner 0.3 (capital letter), Effigy of Cruelty 0.4 (a line added). Unjudged: minions (not in the skill tool), Cold Snap 0.2 and Elemental Siphon 0.3 (tool can't find them in both patches), Hyrri's Ire 0.2, Blackflame 0.4 (reworked), Adonia's Ego 0.4 (level line), Prism of Belief 0.4 (not in 0.4 data).
